title: Location
description: A location in one frame with normalised coordinates (SPEC.md "Locations"). The five copied kinds (bbox, polygon, view, whole_image, absent) are the copied envelope schema's own definition, referenced unchanged; `line` and `stroke` are rascal's.

Point.description: `[x, y]` as fractions of the frame's width and height, each between 0 and 1.

Path.description: Two or more points in order. On a wrapped frame a path is split at the seam into parts that share one `group`.

LineLocation.description: A line the seam band follows: a whole column (`column`, a fraction of the width) or a path, with its full width in pixels.

frame.description: The frame id the coordinates are in.

column.description: The column as a fraction of the frame's width; exclusive with `path`.

width_px.description: The line's full width in pixels of its frame.

group.description: Shared by the parts of one location split at a seam.

StrokeLocation.description: A rough mark along a path with a radius in pixels; `tighten` refines it to the defect's edges.

frame.description: The frame id the coordinates are in.

radius_px.description: The stroke's radius in pixels of its frame.

group.description: Shared by the parts of one location split at a seam.
